Callout.Name: Fence Cut on Farmland
Callout.Message: Boundary fence cut, stock wandering onto the road.
Callout.Advisory: No persons present, several animals loose.

Script.Line: It has been cut with a disc cutter. About forty foot of it.
The stock is on the road and the traffic is not slowing down.
That is twice this month on the same boundary.

Lines.Approach: The fence is cut and half the field is on the road. Somebody did that deliberately.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
